visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video utilizes a split-screen format. The top half features a 2D animation sequence showing characters falling through a surreal, high-contrast space. The bottom half features a female pianist with long, straight black hair, wearing a black and red gothic-style dress with a red lace-up bodice and a red devil-horn headband. She is seated at a black grand piano, her hands moving rapidly across the keys. The background consists of vertical grey and pink curtains under bright studio lighting. (2) The animation in the top frame transitions to show stylized hands reaching out towards each other amidst glowing cyan energy fields. The pianist continues her performance with intense focus, her fingers executing intricate melodies with high speed and precision. The piano's internal mechanism is partially visible on the right side of the frame. (3) The animation accelerates, depicting dynamic action shots with red and green linear energy streaks against shifting color backgrounds. Credits in Japanese and English appear as overlays within the animation frame. The pianist's body sways slightly with the rhythm, her hands leaping across the keyboard to conclude the energetic musical phrase as the video ends.

The recording is studio-clean with a bright spectral centroid, highlighting the upper harmonics of the grand piano. The performance features rapid 16th-note runs and a strong rhythmic drive, typical of an anime theme song. (2) As the musical phrase progresses, the pianist utilizes the full range of the keyboard, maintaining a consistent high-energy arousal level. There is no background noise or speech, resulting in an excellent signal-to-noise ratio. The acoustic texture is percussive due to the hammer strikes on the strings, with clear harmonic purity. (3) The piece reaches a melodic peak with dense chords and syncopated rhythms. The dynamic range is moderate, characteristic of a well-compressed piano recording for social media. The music ends abruptly with a final sustained chord as the clip concludes.
